stepBody: What is the interpretation of $$\hat{\theta}_1?$$ Answer in exactly one sentence.
choices: $$\hat{\theta}_1$$ is the predicted GPA of a student who sleeps one hour per night and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
$$\hat{\theta}_1$$ is the correlation between hours of sleep and GPA among the $$100$$ students.

$$\hat{\theta}_1$$ is the predicted increase in GPA for a student who sleeps one additional hour per night relative to a student who sleeps one fewer hour per night, holding CDSS major status constant.
$$\hat{\theta}_1$$ is the increase in GPA caused by sleeping one additional hour per night, holding CDSS major status constant.
$$\hat{\theta}_1$$ is the predicted increase in hours of sleep for a student whose GPA is one point higher, holding CDSS major status constant.
